page_title: ROM 2-1 VER | AS Roma v Verona 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Juan David Cabal (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+3' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Thomas Henry with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
90+1' Thomas Henry (Verona) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Tomas Suslov (Verona) will deliver the corner kick.
87' A clumsy foul by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle.
85' Verona hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
82' Juan David Cabal (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Rui Patricio comes off his line to gather the ball.
81' That will be all from Stephan El Shaarawy who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Andrea Belotti (AS Roma).
77' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thomas Henry (Verona) replacing Milan Djuric.
77' The substitution is prepared. Juan Manuel Cruz (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Riccardo Saponara.

76' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Michael Folorunsho (Verona) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the right post. Rui Patricio just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
75' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
74' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
72' The resulting corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is cleared.
66' Milan Djuric (Verona) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar.
65' Milan Djuric (Verona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
65' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
65' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Verona! Let's see what he decides.
63' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
62' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
61' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
60' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
58' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) on for Paulo Dybala.
57' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is given a yellow card.
57' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Verona players look gutted.
57' That's a clear yellow card. Diego Llorente (AS Roma) goes into the book.
56' Verona score a goal, but referee Juan Luca Sacchi has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
54' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
53' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
51' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a throw-in.
48' A cross into the box from Juan David Cabal (Verona) is cleared.
46' Marco Baroni has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) comes on the pitch for Jordi Mboula.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Tomas Suslov (Verona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
43' Suat Serdar (Verona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Yellow card. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
41' The ball is cleared after Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
39' AS Roma are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
36' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
32' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi signals NO PENALTY for AS Roma after a VAR review!
32' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
31' Surely that's handball by one of the Verona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
28' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Rasmus Kristensen comes onto the pitch to replace him.
27' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
25' 2 - 0 Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) has a great chance inside the box and slams the ball into the top left corner.
19' 1 - 0 GOAL! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) runs onto a pass from Stephan El Shaarawy after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 1:0.
18' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
17' Tomas Suslov (Verona) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Rui Patricio.
12' Juan Luca Sacchi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) and blew his whistle.
11' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call.
8' A pass lands at the feet of Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
6' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
2' Suat Serdar (Verona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
